results.name: Seated Calf Raises Dumbbell on Knee
instructions: Sit on a bench with your forefeet on the edge of a plate, close together, allowing your heels to hang off. Place a dumbbell on both knees, holding them securely with your hands.
Raise your heels as high as possible, pushing through your forefeet and lifting the dumbbells.
Lower your heels back down to the starting position in a controlled manner. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the left leg and repeat.
tips: Focus on using your calf muscles to lift and lower your heel.
Keep the movement slow and controlled to maximize muscle engagement.
Avoid bouncing or using momentum to lift the weight.
results.description: Seated Calf Raises Dumbbell on Knee is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the calves (lower legs). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category.

results.name: Seated Hip Abductor Machine
instructions: Sit down on the hip abduction machine and place your feet flat on the footrests while positioning your outer thighs against the padded levers.
Grip the side handles to stabilize your upper body and press your legs outward against the resistance, pushing the pads apart in a controlled motion.
Pause for a second at the peak of the movement, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired repetitions.
tips: Sit upright with your back firmly against the backrest to maintain proper posture.
Focus on squeezing your glutes and outer thighs throughout the movement.
Perform the movement slowly and avoid using momentum to push the legs outward.
results.description: Seated Hip Abductor Machine is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with a leverage machine, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Abductors, Core.

results.name: Seated Leg Curl Machine
instructions: Sit on the machine with your back against the backrest and your legs fully extended. Adjust the backrest and leg pads so the pad rests just above your heels.
Pull your heels down by bending your knees until the pad reaches down as far as possible.
Pause for a second, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired repetitions.
tips: Exhale as you curl and inhale as you return to the starting position.
Do not let the weight stack drop; control the descent movement for maximum muscle activation.
Keep your toes pointed forward throughout the exercise.
results.description: Seated Leg Curl Machine is a beginner single-joint isolation pulling exercise targeting the hamstrings (upper legs). Performed with a leverage machine, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Glutes.

results.name: Seated Leg Extension Single Leg
instructions: Sit on the leg extension machine. Position both feet under the padded lever, with the lever resting just above your ankles.
Grip the handles on the sides of the machine for support. Engage your core and keep your back pressed firmly against the backrest.
Extend your right leg by pushing the padded lever upward, straightening your knee, then slowly lower the lever to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Avoid locking your knees at the top of the movement to reduce strain on your joints.
Keep your back pressed firmly against the backrest to maintain proper form.
Exhale as you extend your legs and inhale as you lower them back down.
results.description: Seated Leg Extension Single Leg is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a leverage machine, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors.

results.name: Seated Leg Extension Alternate Legs
instructions: Sit on the leg extension machine. Position both feet under the padded lever, with the lever resting just above your ankles.
Grip the handles on the sides of the machine for support. Engage your core and keep your back pressed firmly against the backrest.
Extend your right leg by pushing the padded lever upward, straightening your knee, then slowly lower the lever to the starting position.
Immediately repeat the movement with your left leg. Alternate between right and left legs for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Avoid locking your knees at the top of the movement to reduce strain on your joints.
Keep your back pressed firmly against the backrest to maintain proper form.
Exhale as you extend your legs and inhale as you lower them back down.
results.description: Seated Leg Extension Alternate Legs is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a leverage machine, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors.

results.name: Seated Machine Hip Adductor
instructions: Sit on a hip abductor machine with your back straight, knees open wide and bent, and feet on the footrests.
Set the padded bars against the inner sides of your knees.
Close your knees to bring the bars together.
As the bars come together, return to the initial position and repeat.
results.description: Seated Machine Hip Adductor is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the adductors (upper legs). Performed with a leverage machine, it falls under the strength category.

results.name: Side Lunges Bodyweight
instructions: Stand upright with your feet hip-width apart and your hands clasped in front of you for balance.
Take a big step to the right with your right foot, lowering your body into a lunge position. Your right knee should be bent and your left leg should remain straight.
Push through your right heel to return to the starting position.
Repeat on the other side by stepping out to the left with your left foot, lowering into a lunge, and then returning to the starting position.
tips: Ensure your knee does not extend past your toes in the lunge position to protect your knee joint.
Maintain a straight back and avoid leaning forward excessively during the lunge.
Breathe steadily, inhaling as you step out and lower into the lunge, and exhaling as you push back to the starting position.
results.description: Side Lunges Bodyweight is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings.
